titolo: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout and Maverick, 17B‑parameter MoE models with 10M context
descr: Llama 4 Scout fits a single H100 GPU, while Maverick runs on a single H100 host, both using MoE routing for multimodal AI.
nota: **Correction, 11 November 2026:** this is not new. Meta released Llama 4 Scout and Maverick on 5 April 2025. Our system wrote this article from a MarkTechPost guide to MoE routing (7 November 2026) that used Llama 4 only as an example. The model facts below come from Meta's April 2025 announcement.
paragrafi: Meta announced two new mixture‑of‑experts (MoE) models: Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick.
Both models have 17 billion active parameters. Scout uses 16 experts and fits on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU with Int4 quantisation.
Maverick employs 128 experts, fits on a single H100 host, and activates 17 B of its 400 B total parameters per token.
"best multimodal model in its class" is used to describe both Scout and Maverick in Meta’s release.
perche: For developers, the models provide high‑quality multimodal performance on a single H100, lowering hardware costs for inference. Users of free or locally hosted models still rely on smaller, non‑MoE solutions, but the open‑weight release may inspire community‑driven equivalents.
